prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: vertical 4:5 social media cover image
Primary request: Photorealistic Japanese-style kyotei motorboat racing at night under bright stadium floodlights, with city lights softly blurred far in the background and calm dark water.
Subject: Two or three authentic kyotei racing boats in a close pack exiting a turn. Each is a single-seat racing boat about 3 meters long, flat, low, and long relative to its racer, with a white or pale-grey hull; an open cockpit with absolutely no canopy, roof, windshield, or bubble; one racer crouching or kneeling low and leaning forward with both hands on a small steering wheel, wearing a completely plain full-face helmet and plain racing suit, face invisible; one outboard motor at the stern producing a large white spray plume.
Composition/framing: Vertical 4:5. Keep every boat in the lower half. The top 45 percent must be dark, visually quiet, empty, and uncluttered for later title overlay. Dynamic close turn-exit action while preserving clean negative space above.
Lighting/mood: Realistic night stadium lighting reflecting subtly on dark water; dramatic but natural sports photography.
Text: none.
Constraints: Boats must unmistakably resemble Japanese kyotei boats, not offshore powerboats or F1 tunnel boats. No recognizable real person.
Avoid: absolutely no text, letters, digits, numbers, logos, brands, watermarks, signage, number plates, flags, emblems, decals, or readable markings anywhere; no canopy; no roof; no windshield bubble; no offshore powerboat or F1 tunnel-boat design.
review: Visually inspected the generated image at full display size; all requested composition and exclusion checks passed.
